description: Simple Planning Tool for Climate Hazards: Arkansas. Louisiana, Oklahoma, & Texas is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Southern Climate Impacts Planning Program. This tool offers a collection of maps and graphs to assist planners and emergency managers in Arkansas. Louisiana, Oklahoma, & Texas. The tool can help them assess their long-term climate risks, both historically and in the future. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Drought, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, High Winds, Severe Winter Weather, Wildfire. Assets: Critical Facilities, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
